title: StoryBlueprint
description: The AI-generated story structure returned by POST /api/generate/blueprint. Matches the BlueprintResponse model in backend/server.py. Note: in a full project export (see demo/captain_blanket_demo.json) characters are stored separately; this schema describes the intermediate API response shape.

examples: Captain Blanket and the Midnight Brother

hook.description: A one-sentence hook that captures the core emotional premise
examples: When darkness falls, one brave big brother discovers that the greatest superpower is love.

theme.description: The central theme or moral of the story
examples: The power of love and protection between siblings

characters.description: Initial character list generated with the blueprint (name + role only; full profiles are in CharacterProfile)

outline.description: Page-by-page story beats. Each element corresponds to one page.

items.description: A single page beat describing the key action or moment on that page
examples: Page 1: Oliver is tucked in bed but hears his baby brother Max fussing. He reaches for his old blanket.

examples.title: Captain Blanket and the Midnight Brother
examples.hook: When darkness falls, one brave big brother discovers that the greatest superpower is love.
examples.summary: Oliver discovers his old baby blanket transforms into a magical cape at bedtime. When shadow monsters threaten his baby brother Max's peaceful sleep, Captain Blanket springs into action!
examples.theme: The power of love and protection between siblings
outline: Page 1: Oliver is tucked in bed but hears his baby brother Max fussing.
Page 2: The blanket transforms into a magnificent cape — Captain Blanket!
Page 3: Captain Blanket sees shadow monsters around Max's crib.
Page 4: The shadows try to steal Max's dreams. Captain Blanket stands firm.
Page 5: Cape creates a shield of golden light. Shadows retreat.
Page 7: Oliver remembers loving moments with Max. Love fills his heart.
Page 8: Love defeats the Nightmare King — he melts into starlight.
Page 9: Max sleeps peacefully. Captain Blanket gives him a gentle pat.
Page 10: Oliver hangs up his cape. Being a big brother is the best superpower.
